title: Lula vs. Flávio Bolsonaro Contest Sharpens Over STF Appointments
detail: Brazilian elections analysis reveals the Lula vs. Flávio Bolsonaro contest has sharpened into a battle over who will control future appointments to the Supreme Court (STF), underscoring the judiciary's central role in the 2026 presidential race.

title: Lula Attacks Flávio Bolsonaro, Claims He Was 'Elected by Organized Crime'
detail: President Lula publicly attacked Flávio Bolsonaro, stating he has no credibility and was 'elected by organized crime,' sharply intensifying the clash in Brazil's 2026 presidential campaign.
